status: PASS for two targeted patched Android fault tests; normal full QA and release verification pending
scope: Explicit opt-in debug fault artifacts on an accelerated API 35 x86_64 emulator, using the bundled multilingual base model and documented public speech fixture. Actual targeted native KV allocation refusal and deterministic in-flight decode barrier; no real host memory exhaustion.

baseline.failure_stage: Native close after the real allocator failure returned to JNI
baseline.evidence_scope: Preserved previously reviewed baseline result; distinct from patched outcomes.

patched_attempt_01.status: FAILED: one test passed; arrival checkpoint wait failed before barrier

test_results.failure: The 30-second arrival allowance expired before reaching the native barrier.

patched_attempt_01.interpretation: The original failure is retained. Preparation-to-refusal milestones did not measure pure encoder time; they motivated a separately bounded arrival allowance without relaxing functional assertions.

verified_behaviors: A real allocator refusal reaches JNI as a transcription exception; the service closes the engine exactly once and leaves pending audio, chunk metadata and reviewed manual edits unchanged.
The ordinary service factory opens a new engine and completes recovery on the same saved audio, preserving its SHA-256 and reviewed passage; recovery never opens the microphone.

Cancellation and handle removal occur while actual decode is paused after its encoder; the decoder retains ownership until release, returns cancellation without output and destroys the engine exactly once.
Repeated cancel/close is harmless and a fresh engine decodes the public fixture.
patched_attempt_02.independent_review: Exact test IDs and status transitions, zero skips, archived APKs, both native ABI hashes, embedded model/fixture hashes and eleven selected source bindings verified. Ten sources remain byte-identical; the recorded pre-activation CMake source was reconstructed exactly from the later one-condition wiring change.

normal_build_integration.status: Ownership overlay enabled in source; full normal QA pending
normal_build_integration.activation: Normal builds select the ownership overlay. Only an explicitly selected fault baseline retains the original engine; fault hooks and Kotlin helper sources require the debug opt-in.

limitations: The two patched tests ran in the dedicated fault artifact before normal-build activation; they do not replace the complete normal debug/release QA cycle.
The baseline native failure and first patched arrival failure remain separate preserved outcomes.
Both native ABIs were archived and hashed, but runtime testing here exercised only x86_64.
The emulator timings and checkpoint wait are validation observations, not phone latency, thermal, battery, background reliability or seven-language recognition measurements.
This covers the specified native failure and lifecycle paths, not arbitrary allocation failures or release acceptance.
